scripts.text: Outside the safety of the city, there is a pink beast known as ^000077Poring^000000.
scripts.translation: 出了安全的城镇，会遇到一种粉红色的生物，叫作^000077波利^000000。

scripts.text: Though it's cute in appearance and does not actively harm people, Poring is known to absorb items that are on the ground into its own body.
scripts.translation: 虽然波利外表可爱，且不会主动攻击人类，但它们会将地上的物品吸收到自己体内。

scripts.text: So if there's something on the ground that you want to pick up, be careful lest it be consumed by a Poring. Then again... Porings are pretty weak...
scripts.translation: 所以如果地上有你想捡的东西，小心别被波利先吞掉了。不过话说回来...波利其实很弱...

scripts.text: The green colored ^000077Poporing^000000 is tougher than Poring. Newbies generally make the mistake of attacking it without being aware of its power... So be careful!
scripts.translation: 绿色的^000077波波利^000000比波利强得多。新手常常不了解它的实力就贸然攻击...可要小心！

scripts.text: The larva of Creamy is Fabre. So, those green little wormy things are actually the babies of those pinkish, purply butterfly things you see around.
scripts.translation: 绿棉虫是克瑞米的幼虫。那些小小的绿色虫子，其实就是你常见的粉紫色蝴蝶的宝宝。

scripts.text: But before Fabres can become Creamys, they go into a pupa stage. When that happens, they turn into these dark purple cocoons we call Pupa. Simple, huh?
scripts.translation: 不过，法布尔变成蜂兵之前会经历蛹的阶段。那时它们会变成深紫色的茧，我们称之为虫蛹。很简单吧？

scripts.text: There's another monster that goes through a really big change... Pickys.
scripts.translation: 还有一种魔物会发生巨大的变化...小鸡。

scripts.text: Pickys are so cute when they're young, but when they grow up, they turn into those big, gawky looking Peco Pecos. Talk about awkward puberty.
scripts.translation: 小鸡小时候很可爱，但长大后，它们会变成那些高大笨拙的大嘴鸟。真是尴尬的青春期啊。

scripts.text: The weather was nice on my day off so my family and I went for a picnic. We chose to go to a slightly secluded area where I saw something really interesting...
scripts.translation: 休息那天天气很好，我就和家人去野餐了。我们挑了个稍微偏僻的地方，在那里看到了很有意思的东西...

scripts.text: It was a large group of Giant Hornets! What was even weirder was that they were all controlled by this one Queen Bee, following her every command.
scripts.translation: 是一大群狂暴蜂兵！更奇怪的是，它们全听一只女王蜂的指挥，她说什么就做什么。

scripts.text: They might just be bugs, but I think they've got the right idea. Men really ought to take commands from us women... We do things right!
scripts.translation: 虽说只是虫子，可我觉得它们做得很对。男人就该听我们女人指挥...我们做事才靠谱！

scripts.text: Although many monsters may look the same, be careful! There are variations among monsters that have the same basic form.
scripts.translation: 许多魔物看着差不多，可千万小心！即使外形相似，魔物也有不同的种类。

scripts.text: One monster, that looks just like a peaceful and weak one that you've already encountered, may actually be wild and ferocious!
scripts.translation: 有些魔物，看着跟你遇过的温顺弱小的魔物一模一样，实际上却可能非常凶猛！

scripts.text: You can tell these kinds of monsters apart by their body color. Wilder and more powerful monsters have more dangerous looking colors.
scripts.translation: 可以通过体色分辨它们。越凶猛、越强大的魔物，颜色通常也越显得危险。

scripts.text: Here, in Rune-Midgarts, we serve Odin, the fearsome god who sacrificed one of his eyes in order to acquire wisdom.
scripts.translation: 在卢恩·米德加兹，我们侍奉奥丁。这位威严的神明，为了获得智慧，牺牲了自己的一只眼睛。

scripts.text: The statue you see behind of me is a sculpture of mighty Odin. But, it's a shame because it's such a bad likeness.
scripts.translation: 我身后那座雕像，雕的就是伟大的奥丁。可惜，实在不怎么像。

scripts.text: I mean, this statue is totally different from our image of Odin. I guess the sculptor took too many artistic liberties.
scripts.translation: 这雕像跟我们心目中的奥丁，完全不是一回事。看来雕刻家自由发挥得太过头了。

scripts.text: I bet the first time you saw this statue, you thought, '^3355FFOh, what a nice muscle man on a horse^000000.'
scripts.translation: 我敢打赌，你第一次看到这座雕像时，心里一定在想：“^3355FF哇，马背上那个肌肉男真帅^000000。”

scripts.text: But this statue is obviously not muscular enough, not godly enough to fairly represent a god! Maybe if he had a halo?
scripts.translation: 可这雕像显然不够壮，也不够神圣，哪能体现神的风采！要是加个光环，会不会好点？
我知道，我知道...得先当剑士嘛。只要不断练习，我就能成为很厉害的剑士。

scripts.text: First, I gotta be a Swordie. But if I keep practicing, I can become an awesome Swordie. And then after that...
It's... It's my most precious dream.
scripts.translation: 这...这是我最珍贵的梦想。

scripts.text: Hey, if you wanna become a Swordie, you gotta go to Izlude. There, you can go ahead and take the Swordman job test. The first time, I, um, failed miserably. But I won't fail again!
scripts.translation: 嘿，想成为剑士的话，就去依斯鲁得参加剑士转职考试。我第一次考得一塌糊涂，不过这次绝不会再失败！

scripts.text: Training! Training! Gotta keep training! You need to be strong too! Once we both get stronger, we'll meet again!
scripts.translation: 训练！训练！得不停训练！你也要变强！等我们都厉害了，再见面吧！

scripts.text: Heh heh! I will for sure! 'Strife, the courageous Knight.' It sounds cool, doesn't it?
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿！我一定会的！“勇敢的骑士斯特莱夫。”听起来很酷吧？

scripts.text: You look different now. *Gasp* You've gotten... ^993333stronger^000000. Wow, that's so coooool!
scripts.translation: 你现在看起来不一样了。*吸气* 你变得...^993333更强了^000000。哇，也太酷了吧！

scripts.text: This is, well, for you to help you get even stronger. I guess I want to thank you for being such a good example.
scripts.translation: 这个，呃，送给你，帮你变得更强。你给我树立了好榜样，我想谢谢你。
我知道，我知道...得先当剑士嘛。只要不断练习，我就能成为很厉害的剑士。

scripts.text: First, I gotta be a Swordie. But if I keep practicing, I can become an awesome Swordie. And then after that...
It's... It's my most precious dream.
scripts.translation: 这...这是我最珍贵的梦想。

scripts.text: Yes, yes of course! Someday, I'll even be as strong as you! When that day comes, I hope that we can train together!
scripts.translation: 是啊，当然！总有一天，我会和你一样强！到时候，希望能一起训练！

scripts.text: Fine! But I'm gonna keep on training, and we'll see who gets the last laugh!
scripts.translation: 好啊！不过我会继续训练，到时候看谁笑到最后！

scripts.text: The streets are too crowded these days. *Cough Cough* Look at all this dust, not everything about living in the capital city is good. Anyway, may I help you?
scripts.translation: 最近街上人太多了。*咳咳* 你看这些灰尘，住在首都也不全是好事嘛。那么，有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I wonder if you are interested in parties or dresses. Hehehe. These days, the hot topic is definitely the colorful, extravagant, magnificent dresses you can wear.
scripts.translation: 你对宴会礼服感兴趣吗？嘿嘿。最近最热门的话题，肯定是那些色彩缤纷、华丽非凡的漂亮礼服。

scripts.text: To get such dazzling colors, I heard you have to use a dye that you can only get in Morocc. But I also heard that the price is beyond imagination.
scripts.translation: 听说，要染出那么耀眼的颜色，得用梦罗克独有的染料。不过，价格也贵得难以想象。

scripts.text: Aahhhh~ I wish I could wear such a dress. Even if it's just once...
scripts.translation: 啊~真想穿一次那样的礼服，哪怕只有一次也好...

scripts.text: Eh~? Why talk to me in the first place? What a strange person.
scripts.translation: 诶~？不聊的话，干吗还来找我？真是个怪人。

scripts.text: Here in the Eastern branch of the Prontera Library, we provide Monster Encyclopedias in which creatures are organized by their properties. We also have books on Merchant and Blacksmith skills.
scripts.translation: 这里是普隆德拉图书馆东分馆，收藏了按属性分类的《魔物图鉴》，也有介绍商人和铁匠技能的书。

scripts.text: Ooh~! The other branch of our library also has many interesting things to read! So if you get a chance, you just might want to visit.
scripts.translation: 哦~另一个分馆也有许多有趣的读物！有机会，不妨去看看。

scripts.text: The Prontera Culvert sewers have been left unattended for a long time. Now that place is infested with ^000077Thief Bugs^000000!
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉下水道已经很久没人打理了。现在那个地方全是^000077浮勒盗虫^000000！

scripts.text: These Thief Bugs seem to quickly grab items dropped on the ground, and then run away with them... They're even more annoying than cockroaches!!
scripts.translation: 这些浮勒盗虫，地上掉了东西就赶紧捡走，再带着跑掉...比蟑螂还烦人！！

scripts.text: I dunno if you'll believe me, but I saw the weirdest thing down in the ^000077Culvert Sewers^000000...
scripts.translation: 不知道您信不信，我在^000077下水道^000000里看到了最奇怪的东西...

scripts.text: I've been training in the 3rd level for so long that there isn't anything that I don't know about in that area. But when I finally went to the 4th level...
scripts.translation: 我在第三层训练了这么久，那里的一草一木我都了如指掌。但是当我终于下到第四层时...

scripts.text: There, I saw a shimmering light. I was completely captivated and went to approach it. It must have been some sort of beautiful fairy...
scripts.translation: 在那里，我看到了一束闪烁的光芒。我完全被迷住了，便走上前去。那一定是某种美丽的妖精...

scripts.text: I've never seen a Thief Bug shining with light before! Man, just when you think you've seen it all...
scripts.translation: 我从没见过会发光的浮勒盗虫！唉，还以为自己什么都见识过了...

scripts.text: Sigh...as more and more people coming into Prontera,
scripts.translation: 唉...来普隆德拉的人越来越多，

scripts.text: better and better my business has become nowadays. But...
scripts.translation: 最近我的生意也越来越好了。但是...

scripts.text: Well, I am having a hard time to keep a good stock of food ingredients.
scripts.translation: 唉，食材库存却越来越难以维持。

scripts.text: As you see, the numbers of the monsters outside of town has been greatly increased and they have caused trouble to my suppliers to deliver the goods at a right time.
scripts.translation: 城外魔物越来越多，供应商也没法按时送货。

scripts.text: I cannot make my ultra nice menus with common ingredients because they are super special!
scripts.translation: 我的招牌菜可不是普通食材能做的，原料都特别得很！

scripts.text: So I have been contacting super heavy champion hunters for fresh and special ingredients.
scripts.translation: 所以，我一直找那些顶尖的狩猎高手，帮忙弄来新鲜又特别的食材。

scripts.text: But the demand has exceeded the supply in these days.
I can't keep my business busy without my special menu 'Crunch Crunch Sour' and 'Savory Yum Yum'...*Sigh*
scripts.translation: 没了招牌菜“脆脆酸”和“美味滋滋”，生意哪还能这么红火...*唉*

scripts.text: The basic ingredients of my Crunch Crunch Sour are the ants roaming inside the Ant Hell in the desert.
scripts.translation: “脆脆酸”的主要原料，是沙漠里蚂蚁地狱的蚂蚁。

scripts.text: Rumor has it that the numbers of the ants have been greatly increased and they have become more violent, so that no one wants to get in the place.
scripts.translation: 可听说它们越来越多，也越来越凶，谁都不愿进去。

scripts.text: *Sigh*...I am afraid that my business days are numbered now.
scripts.translation: *唉*...恐怕这生意，也做不了几天了。

scripts.text: Savory Yum Yum's basic ingredients are the grasshoppers romping in a place over the west forest. Yeah, it is the best selling menu ever.
scripts.translation: “美味滋滋”的主要原料，是西边森林另一头蹦来蹦去的蚱蜢。这可是店里最畅销的菜。

scripts.text: Rumor has it that they have become very violent and Bees have built their habitat in the place, so that no one wants to get in there.
scripts.translation: 可听说它们变得很凶，蜜蜂也在那里筑了巢，谁都不愿过去。

scripts.text: *Sigh*...I am afraid that my business days are numbered now.
scripts.translation: *唉*...恐怕这生意，也做不了几天了。

scripts.text: Hey, come on over and let's drink! I have lots of interesting stories to tell!
scripts.translation: 嘿，过来喝一杯吧！我有好多有趣的故事要讲！

scripts.text: I know lots of things about Prontera. I have seen many fine views and I also have explored some monster lairs around this city.
scripts.translation: 我对普隆德拉很了解。我见过许多美景，也探索过这座城周围的魔物巢穴。

scripts.text: How could you enter monster lairs?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么进入魔物巢穴的？

scripts.text: I may appear to be a drunken man but I am more than meets the eye.
scripts.translation: 我看着像个醉汉，可没那么简单。

scripts.text: Well, I happened to enter the places for carrying weapons for hunters or for delivering stuffs and whatsoever.
scripts.translation: 我去那些地方，是给猎人运武器，或者送些别的东西。

scripts.text: You might think of me as a mere delivery guy,
scripts.translation: 你可能觉得，我不就是个送货的，

scripts.text: But I am very proud of my job. You know how tough the world has become?
scripts.translation: 可我为自己的工作感到自豪。你知道如今这世道有多难吗？

scripts.text: No matter how hard a work is, I am not afraid of doing that.
scripts.translation: 不管活多苦多累，我都不怕。

scripts.text: Anyways, that is how I have explored some strange places like monster lairs...
scripts.translation: 总之，我就是这样探索了一些奇怪的地方，比如魔物巢穴...

scripts.text: That is also a reason why I keep my job.
scripts.translation: 这也是我继续做这份工作的原因。

scripts.text: Ah, I just recall being inside the maze and the spooky forest!
scripts.translation: 啊，我想起迷宫和那片阴森森林了！

scripts.text: Yes. Few days ago, I have entered a mysterious maze following a group of hunters at the north of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 是的。几天前，我跟随一群猎人进入了普隆德拉北边的一个神秘迷宫。

scripts.text: They said that they could get lots and lots of rare items from the maze even if the maze was filled with awfully strong monsters.
scripts.translation: 他们说，迷宫里的魔物虽然强得可怕，却能找到好多稀有物品。

scripts.text: So we went there but as soon as we entered, we were just stuck inside the maze, you know.
scripts.translation: 于是我们去了，可刚一进去，就困在里面了。

scripts.text: We were just circling around and then we decided to leave the place. That was one hell of the maze.
scripts.translation: 我们绕来绕去，最后只好决定离开。那迷宫可真够呛。

scripts.text: But I made up my mind that I would successfully explore the maze one day.
scripts.translation: 不过，我下定决心，总有一天要把它探索清楚。

scripts.text: Err? Haven't you still toured the outside of Prontera?
scripts.translation: 咦？你还没逛过普隆德拉城外？

scripts.text: The maze can be found inside a forest at the north of Prontera. Go check the north west side of the forest.
scripts.translation: 迷宫就在城北的一片森林里，去森林西北边找找。

scripts.text: Yeap, be careful when you adventure alone~
scripts.translation: 没错，独自冒险时要小心~

scripts.text: When you go outside of Prontera heading to north east, you will arrive at the peaceful ruins. I have been there a while ago, to deliver something to a priest.
scripts.translation: 出普隆德拉往东北走，会到一片宁静的遗迹。前阵子我给一位牧师送东西，去过那里。

scripts.text: I had to pass a forest on the way to the ruins, and the forest was filled with monkeys and raccoons.
scripts.translation: 路上得穿过一片森林，里面全是猴子和浣熊。

scripts.text: Be forewarned that the forest is not a place to go on a picnic. If you drop something on the ground, the monkeys come out from nowhere and take away all of your possessions.
scripts.translation: 先提醒你，那片森林可不适合野餐。地上掉点东西，猴子就会不知从哪儿冒出来，把你的东西全抢走。

scripts.text: There is no road directly leads to the ruins. But if you go north and keep heading to east, you will get there.
scripts.translation: 没有直达遗迹的路，不过，先往北，再一直往东，就能到。

scripts.text: Oh, be careful on your way to the ruins because there are some weird plant things that assault passersby for no reason.
scripts.translation: 路上要小心，有些古怪的植物会无缘无故袭击路人。

scripts.text: Yeap, be careful when you adventure alone~
scripts.translation: 没错，独自冒险时要小心~

scripts.text: Yeap, be careful when you adventure alone~
scripts.translation: 没错，独自冒险时要小心~

scripts.text: Sick and tired of killing monsters on fields and in dungeons already? Come on...
scripts.translation: 已经厌倦了在原野和地下城里打魔物吗？别这样...

scripts.text: Hahaha, it seems you're pretty confident of your strength, huh? Hmm... Why don't you go join a guild? I mean, all the tough guys are going it.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，对自己的实力挺有信心嘛？嗯...不如加入个公会？厉害的人可都这么做。

scripts.text: Personally though, I don't know any guilds, so you'll have to ask around. Make some contacts, connections, you know, networking.
scripts.translation: 不过我不认识什么公会，所以你得四处打听。结识些人、建立人脉，你懂的，多交际。

scripts.text: I don't even know if you don't like taking orders, but if that's the case, why don't you make your own guild?
scripts.translation: 也不知道你是不是不喜欢听人指挥。要是这样，不如自己建个公会？

scripts.text: One time I walked all the way to Al de Baran, instead of taking a warp. It was pretty dangerous with all those monsters!
scripts.translation: 有次我没坐传送，而是一路走到了艾尔帕兰。路上全是魔物，可危险了！

scripts.text: I almost died! Some of those monsters just kept following me and trying to kill me, even though I did nothing to them! It was pretty crazy.
scripts.translation: 我差点没命！有些魔物一直追着我，非要杀我，可我根本没招惹它们！真够疯的。

scripts.text: Well, still, I feel that taking the scenic route was worth it. There were some pretty magnificent sights on the way.
scripts.translation: 不过，走这条路看看风景，还是值得的。沿途景色壮观极了。

scripts.text: Even the city of Al de Baran is a splendid vision to the eyes, with its elegant architecture and romantic canal.
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰本身也很美，有优雅的建筑，还有浪漫的运河。

scripts.text: The headquarters of Kafra Corporation is also located in Al de Baran. You should really stop by and check it out for yourself.
scripts.translation: 卡普拉公司的总部也在艾尔帕兰。你真该亲自去看看。
特里斯坦三世国王统治。

scripts.text: We really owe the prosperity of Rune-Midgarts to him. He was able to convince the people to welcome outsiders into Prontera, as well as establish trade to foreign lands, like Amatsu and Kunlun.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹能这么繁荣，都得感谢他。他说服民众接纳来到普隆德拉的外乡人，还开通了与樱花城、昆仑等地的贸易。

scripts.text: It can be hard to believe he's such a brilliant and capable leader.
scripts.translation: 真让人难以相信他竟是如此英明能干的领袖。

scripts.text: After all, the only time I see him is when he's conducting weddings. Even if a wedding isn't going on, he's still kind of loitering around the Prontera church!
scripts.translation: 毕竟，我见到他的时候，通常都是他在主持婚礼。即使没有婚礼，他也总是在普隆德拉教堂附近闲逛！

scripts.text: I guess you can get away with a lot of things when you happen to be lord and ruler of an entire nation.
scripts.translation: 想来，身为一个国家的君主，很多事都能睁一只眼闭一只眼吧。

scripts.text: Whether it's schmoozing with a member of the opposite sex, or battling monsters, I gotta say, it's all about ^333399skills^000000.
scripts.translation: 不管是跟异性套近乎，还是跟魔物打架，说到底，靠的都是^333399技巧^000000。

scripts.text: I can't help you much when it comes to the subject of talking to attractive women such as myself, but I can tell you a little more about skills that help in battle.
scripts.translation: 至于怎么跟我这样迷人的女人聊天，我帮不了你多少。不过，战斗技能，我倒能跟你说说。

scripts.text: I don't really have any advice for skills when it comes to talking to a cute guy, but I can let you in on what I know about skills that help in battle.
scripts.translation: 至于怎么和帅哥聊天，我可没什么技能建议。不过，战斗中有用的技能，我倒可以跟你讲讲。

scripts.text: For most skills, the maximum level is level 10. It's easy to stress yourself out, since it takes so many points to completely master a skill. What skills should you choose?!
scripts.translation: 大多数技能的最高等级是10级。要把技能练满需要很多技能点，很容易让人伤脑筋。到底该选哪些技能呢？！

scripts.text: After all, if you spend too many skill points on one skill, you might not be able to learn another. That's right, there's a limit to the number of total skill points you can earn.
scripts.translation: 毕竟，一个技能投入太多，就可能没法学习其他技能。没错，能获得的技能点总数是有限的。

scripts.text: But you know what? Not every skill is mastered at level 10. You can master some skills at only level 5. And even better, some skills are already mastered at level 1 or 2.
scripts.translation: 不过，也不是所有技能都得升到 10 级。有些 5 级就满了，有些甚至只要 1 级或 2 级。

scripts.text: So relax and plan ahead, so you can master all the skills that you really want to master the most. Also, don't just put skill points into anything. Remember to use your skill points wisely.
scripts.translation: 放轻松，提前规划，才能学会自己最想掌握的技能。另外别随便把技能点都用掉，记得明智分配。

scripts.text: Mmm, good. I think I'll be able to finish before tonight's party.
scripts.translation: 嗯，不错。我想我能在今晚的派对前完工。

scripts.text: Oh! I didn't realize I had a guest. How may I help you?
scripts.translation: 哦！没注意到有客人。请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Life may have gotten a little better, but receiving all these orders? *Whew!* Young ladies these days must be very well off, so my services may no longer be a luxury.
scripts.translation: 生活或许好过了一些，可订单也太多了吧？*呼！*现在的年轻小姐们看来都很富裕，我的服务恐怕不再算奢侈品了。

scripts.text: Well, people like them probably further the pursuit of beauty and fashion. But, of course, that's only my opinion.
scripts.translation: 像她们这样的人，或许也推动了大家对美与时尚的追求。不过，这只是我的看法。

scripts.text: I believe for us humans, clothes are one of the few ways to show our personality, style, and beauty.
scripts.translation: 我认为，服装是我们展现个性、风格和美的少数方式之一。

scripts.text: Considering this, I personally think my job is very helpful and rather fancy. This in itself makes it all worthwhile. Coarse fabric and rough leather burst with energy and life when colored...
scripts.translation: 因此，我个人觉得自己的工作既实用又时髦。光是这一点就值得了。粗糙的布料和皮革染上颜色后，便焕发出活力...

scripts.text: It is a very hard and tedious process, but the happiness and delight you feel when your clothes are done makes up for all the hard work.
scripts.translation: 过程是辛苦又繁琐，可看见衣服做好后，你那高兴的样子，一切辛苦就都值得了。

scripts.text: I don't have enough time to dye your clothes right now. I have so many orders that are still waiting to be done.
scripts.translation: 我现在没时间帮你染衣服，还有好多订单等着处理。

scripts.text: I'm sorry for the inconvenience, but could you come back again next time?
scripts.translation: 给您添麻烦了，能不能改天再来？

scripts.text: Feel free to take your time and relax here. I apologize that I have nothing to serve you, though.
scripts.translation: 您尽管在这里坐坐，歇一歇。只是没什么能招待您，真不好意思。

scripts.text: Are you interested in learning more about helping and supporting other people?
scripts.translation: 你想进一步了解如何帮助和支援他人吗？

scripts.text: The Acolytes and Priests trained in this church can heal people, cure them of certain conditions, and even awaken the battle potential of other adventurers.
scripts.translation: 这里培养的服事和牧师，能治愈伤痛、解除某些异常状态，甚至能激发其他冒险者的战斗潜能。

scripts.text: Go and ahead and ask if you have any questions about skills for Acolytes and Priests.
scripts.translation: 服事和牧师的技能，有什么想知道的，尽管问我。

scripts.text: You can recover your own HP with the ^6666CCHeal^000000 skill. Healing is one of the most important ways you can help your friends in battle.
scripts.translation: ^6666CC治愈术^000000可以恢复自己的 HP。在战斗中，治疗也是帮助同伴最重要的手段之一。

scripts.text: Even though our powers are usually used to heal others, you can actually use the ^6666CCHeal^000000 skill to hurt Undead monsters.
scripts.translation: 我们的力量通常用于治疗，不过，^6666CC治愈术^000000也能伤害不死系魔物。

scripts.text: Just remember to hold down the ^6666CCShift^000000 key when you use Cure or Heal on Undead monsters. Just be sure to hurt the monsters though, and don't use it to help monsters.
scripts.translation: 对不死系魔物使用治愈或光耀之堂时，记得按住^6666CCShift^000000键。不过要确认是在伤害魔物，可别用它来帮助魔物。

scripts.text: Later, if you've learned ^6666CCHeal^000000 as an Acolyte, you can learn ^6666CCSanctuary^000000 if you become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 服事学会^6666CC治愈术^000000后，日后转职为牧师，就能学习^6666CC光耀之堂^000000。

scripts.text: Priests use ^6666CCSantuary^000000 to create an area which will restore the HP of you and your friends if you rest within the Sanctuary's area.
scripts.translation: 牧师施展^6666CC光耀之堂^000000，会形成一片区域。你和同伴在其中休息，就能恢复 HP。

scripts.text: Once you reach ^6666CCLevel 2 Heal^000000 as an Acolyte, you can learn ^6666CCCure^000000, which can be used to treat abnormal statuses.
scripts.translation: 服事将^6666CC治愈术练到 2 级^000000后，就能学习^6666CC治疗术^000000，用来解除异常状态。

scripts.text: This skill can be such a life saver, since almost every abnormal status can be cured with the Cure skill. Just remember that you need ^6666CCLevel 2 Heal^000000 before you can learn Cure.
scripts.translation: 治愈术能解除几乎所有异常状态，关键时刻可以救命。记住，必须先学会^6666CC治愈术2级^000000，才能学习治愈术。

scripts.text: Now, the ^6666CCIncrease AGI^000000 skill can be used on you or your friends. For a while your AGI stat is increased, making you attack faster and dodge monster attacks more easily.
scripts.translation: ^6666CC敏捷提升^000000可以对自己或同伴使用，暂时提高 AGI，让攻击更快，也更容易躲开魔物的攻击。

scripts.text: If you're an Acolyte that wants to learn ^6666CCIncrease AGI^000000, you need to learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Heal^000000 first.
scripts.translation: 服事想学习^6666CC敏捷提升^000000，得先将^6666CC治愈术练到 3 级^000000。

scripts.text: You can use ^6666CCAngelus^000000 to increase your Defense, as well as the Defense of other party members. Remember though, you can only use ^6666CCAngelus^000000 on other people if they are in your party.
scripts.translation: 使用^6666CC天使之障壁^000000可以提高自己的防御，也能提高其他队员的防御。不过，只有队伍成员才能受到^6666CC天使之障壁^000000的效果。

scripts.text: Before you can learn Angelus, you will need to have ^6666CCLevel 3 Divine Protection^000000.
scripts.translation: 想学习天使之障壁，得先将^6666CC天使之护练到 3 级^000000。

scripts.text: Also, if you keep learning Angelus, you'll eventually be able to learn ^6666CCKyrie Eleison^000000. That skill helps you evade initial attacks automatically.
scripts.translation: 继续修炼天使之障壁，之后还能学习^6666CC霸邪之阵^000000，自动挡下最初受到的攻击。

scripts.text: ^6666CCBlessing^000000 temporarily increases STR, DEX and INT. This skill will give you and your friends a great advantage in battle!
scripts.translation: ^6666CC天使之赐福^000000能暂时提高 STR、DEX 和 INT，让你和同伴在战斗中占据很大优势！

scripts.text: Before you can learn Blessing, you must first learn ^6666CCLevel 5 Divine Protection^000000.
scripts.translation: 想学习天使之赐福，得先将^6666CC天使之护练到 5 级^000000。

scripts.text: ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000 is a pretty complex skill, and you need to know some other skills before you can learn it.
scripts.translation: ^6666CC传送之阵^000000比较复杂，要先学会其他几个技能，才能学习它。

scripts.text: First, you need to learn ^6666CCRuwach^000000 which lets you see invisible monsters. After Ruwach, you will need to learn the ^6666CCTeleport^000000 skill.
scripts.translation: 先学^6666CC光猎^000000，便能发现隐形的魔物。之后，再学习^6666CC瞬间移动^000000。

scripts.text: Once you learn ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000, the level of the Warp Portal skill will determine how many warp destinations, or Warp Points, you can memorize.
scripts.translation: 学会^6666CC传送之阵^000000后，技能等级决定了你能记忆多少个传送目的地，也就是传送点。

scripts.text: If you master the Warp Portal skill, you can have a maximum of 4 different Warp Points. But at least one Warp Point is designated as the Save Point that you've made with a Kafra Employee.
scripts.translation: 传送之阵练满，最多能有 4 个不同的传送点。其中至少一个，是你在卡普拉职员处设置的储存点。

scripts.text: Well, it's a bit of hassle, but if you want to make a certain place one of your Warp Points, you need to be physically there first. Then, type in ^6666CC/memo^000000 into the command prompt.
scripts.translation: 想把某个地方记为传送点，得先亲自到那里。虽然有点麻烦，但只要在指令栏输入^6666CC/memo^000000就行了。

scripts.text: Just so you know, you can't save a Warp Point inside of a dungeon. Oh, and don't forget, each time you make a Warp Portal, you must use 1 ^6666CCBlue Gemstone^000000 as a Catalyst.
scripts.translation: 顺便提醒你，地下城里不能记录传送点。还有，每次使用瞬间移动之阵，都要消耗1颗^6666CC蓝色魔力矿石^000000作为媒介。

scripts.text: We Priests and Acolytes are not only limited to easing the suffering of our fellow man...
scripts.translation: 我们牧师和服事的职责，可不只是减轻同胞的苦痛...

scripts.text: We also mete swift and merciless punishment to the forces of evil. Well, purifying any poor souls that may have been turned into the Undead is also another duty.
scripts.translation: 我们也会迅速而毫不留情地惩戒邪恶势力。净化那些不幸化为亡灵的灵魂，也是我们的职责。

scripts.text: Did you have any questions about Acolyte and Priest skills?
scripts.translation: 你对服事和牧师的技能还有什么疑问吗？

scripts.text: If you want to permanently improve your Defense against the Undead, learn ^6666CCDivine Protection^000000.
scripts.translation: 想永久提高对不死系魔物的防御力，就学习^6666CC天使之护^000000。

scripts.text: Learning Divine Protection to certain levels will also allow you to learn other skills, like ^6666CCAngelus^000000 and ^6666CCBlessing^000000, which Garnet can explain.
scripts.translation: 天使之护达到一定等级，就能学习^6666CC天使之障壁^000000、^6666CC天使之赐福^000000等技能。具体可以请加尔内特讲解。

scripts.text: When you learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Divine Protection^000000, you will then be able to learn the ^6666CCDemon Bane^000000 skill.
scripts.translation: 将^6666CC天使之护练到 3 级^000000，就能学习^6666CC天使之击^000000。

scripts.text: With ^6666CCDemon Bane^000000, the damage of your attacks against the Undead will be increased. Permanently.
scripts.translation: 学会^6666CC天使之击^000000，对不死系魔物的攻击伤害就会提高。永久提高。

scripts.text: ^6666CCDemon Bane^000000 increases the damage you will inflict upon the Undead. Permanently.
scripts.translation: ^6666CC天使之击^000000能提高你对不死系魔物造成的伤害，而且是永久的。

scripts.text: First, you'll need to learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Divine Protection^000000 to be able to learn Demon Bane, so keep that in mind.
scripts.translation: 记住，得先将^6666CC天使之护练到 3 级^000000，才能学习天使之击。

scripts.text: When you learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Demon Bane^000000, you will be able to learn ^6666CCSignum Crusis^000000, which lowers the Defense of Undead monsters, as well as monsters with the Dark property.
scripts.translation: 将^6666CC天使之击练到 3 级^000000，就能学习^6666CC十字军之印^000000，降低不死系魔物与暗属性魔物的防御力。

scripts.text: Using ^6666CCDecrease AGI^000000 on monsters will slow their movement, attack speed, and the rate at which they can evade your own attacks. That way, you can maim them properly.
scripts.translation: 对魔物施展^6666CC缓速术^000000，能降低它们的移动速度、攻击速度和闪避能力，让你更容易重创它们。

scripts.text: Remember, you must first learn ^6666CCLevel 2 Increase AGI^000000 if you want to be able to learn the Decrease AGI skill.
scripts.translation: 想学习缓速术，记得先将^6666CC敏捷提升练到 2 级^000000。

scripts.text: The ^6666CCSignum Crusis^000000 skill lowers the Defense of monsters with the Undead or Dark properties. It has a wide range and can be quite powerful.
scripts.translation: ^6666CC十字军之印^000000能降低不死属性或暗属性魔物的防御力，作用范围很广，效果也相当强。

scripts.text: However, it's a very difficult skill to use, and it has a relatively low success rate. But, do not despair if this skill is not successful all the time.
scripts.translation: 不过，这技能不容易施展，成功率也不高。偶尔失败，可别灰心。

scripts.text: When it does work, it will give you a great battle advantage. Remember, you will ^6666CCLevel 3 Demon Bane^000000 to acquire this skill.
scripts.translation: 一旦成功，就能让你在战斗中占据很大优势。记住，得有^6666CC3 级天使之击^000000，才能学习这个技能。

scripts.text: The ^6666CCPneuma^000000 allows you to generate a barrier that will block all long-range attacks in a certain range, creating a zone that will protect you from monsters that attack from a distance.
scripts.translation: ^6666CC光之障壁^000000能形成一片屏障，在一定范围内阻挡所有远程攻击，保护你免受远处魔物的袭击。

scripts.text: In order to become ready to learn Pneuma, you must first completely master the ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000 skill.
scripts.translation: 先将^6666CC传送之阵^000000练满，才能学习光之障壁。

scripts.text: Nothing can escape the eyes of the Holy! ^6666CCRuwach^000000 allows you to see monsters, as well as other adventurers, that are hidden or invisible.
scripts.translation: 没有什么能逃过神圣的目光！^6666CC光猎^000000能让你发现隐藏或隐形的魔物，也能发现其他冒险者。

scripts.text: Once you learn Ruwach, you will be able to learn the ^6666CCTeleport^000000 skill.
scripts.translation: 学会光猎，就能学习^6666CC瞬间移动^000000。

scripts.text: First, you must learn the ^6666CCRuwach^000000 skill in order to learn how to Teleport.
scripts.translation: 想学习瞬间移动，得先学会^6666CC光猎^000000。

scripts.text: The ^6666CCTeleport^000000 skill teleports you to a random location in the field or city which you are currently in. Teleport will prove useful for quick escapes, but where you may end up is... unpredictable.
scripts.translation: ^6666CC瞬间移动^000000能将你传送到当前原野或城镇的随机地点。它很适合用来迅速脱身，但落脚点...无法预料。

scripts.text: Once the Teleport skill is mastered, you can Teleport to the latest Save Point that you have made with a Kafra Employee. I do not know why it is that way, but the Lord works in mysterious ways.
scripts.translation: 瞬间移动术练满后，你可以传送到最近一次在卡普拉职员处记录的存储点。我也不明白为什么会这样，不过神的旨意总是难以捉摸。

scripts.text: When Teleport is mastered, you can also learn the ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000 skill. Ask Garnet if you wish to know more about Warp Portal.
scripts.translation: 瞬间移动练满，还能学习^6666CC传送之阵^000000。想多了解一些，就去问加尔内特。

scripts.text: If you wish to understand more about an Acolyte or Priest skill, you are welcome to visit me at any time.
scripts.translation: 如果你想进一步了解服事或牧师技能，欢迎随时来找我。

scripts.text: Don't you know there's a Demon living in this forest?! I can't guarantee your safety
scripts.translation: 你不知道这片森林里住着恶魔吗？！我可不能保证你的安全

scripts.text: *Sigh...* The last guy that entered this place haven't come back at all. He didn't listen to me and went in to gather Herbs or something dumb like that...
scripts.translation: *唉...* 上次进去的人，到现在都没回来。他不听劝，非要进去采药，还是做什么蠢事...

scripts.text: Whaaaat a stupid guy. Why would anyone want to throw his life away just to collect some silly Herbs?
scripts.translation: 真是个大蠢货。谁会为了几株破草药，就把命搭进去？
